scope: All 153 workbook pairs; 27 contact sheets plus enlarged source-image comparisons for initial disagreements; crop alignment is supporting evidence only.
limitations: AI review is not the independent review by member 5.
Agreement is not proof that two files originated from the same camera exposure.
Only the fixed candidate list was reviewed; no claim of exhaustive duplicate detection.
